summary: This Form 6-K filed by CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd. reports the results of an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders held on July 29, 2026, where shareholders approved a proposal described in a prior notice dated July 7, 2026. No specific deal terms or special situation triggers are disclosed; the filing merely confirms shareholder approval of a routine corporate proposal. There is no indication of a merger, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation. This is a standard administrative update for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K reporting meeting results. What to watch: none; this filing is procedural and does not signal an event-driven opportunity.
